text:
alex (support): FYI escalating Oakview Health — onboarding stuck, SSO failed verification and provisioning quota is at 0/10 GPUs. Customer is flagging renewal risk if we don't unblock by EOD Wednesday.

maya (CSM): ack. thanks for flagging. any error logs from SSO step? is this a new tenant?

alex (support): New tenant. Error during SAML assertion: 'AudienceMismatch' and then provisioning job errored with 504 on the GPU allocator. pasted logs below:
```
ERROR SAML: AudienceMismatch for issuer https://oakview-idp.example
WARN Provisioner: allocation timeout after 30s -> 504
```

alex (support): tried re-run of provisioning job — same 504. ETA on an eng look? customer is asking for an ETA to share with their CTO.

sasha (eng): looking. allocation 504 is coming from quota-check -> our internal pool returned empty for region us-west-2. Could be reserved capacity mis-assignment. Pulling pool state now.

maya (CSM): I'll take point on customer comms. Proposed comms: 1) immediate honest update to CTO with timeline 2) daily progress note until resolved 3) offer warm seats on shared hosted pool if they need short-term capacity. Agree?

todd (AM): +1 on offering temporary hosted seats, we should cc renewals mgr. We also need to capture risk level for ops team and start a renewal protection playbook if not resolved in 48h.

ops-bot: New escalation ticket created: ESC-2026-0142. Linked resources: prov-job-1829, saml-assert-4567.

sasha (eng): quick mitigation: I can re-route Oakview to fallback pool (hosted-burst-01) which has capacity, requires opt-in flag on tenant. If we do that now we can get them back online in ~20m. Will need approval for cross-tenant routing.

alex (support): customer asked for immediate fix, they approved fallback as long as data isolation is preserved.

maya (CSM): ok locking in plan: 1) sasha to execute fallback routing (target by +20m) 2) eng to debug reserved capacity mapping and fix (ETA 24h) 3) I will send CTO note in 10m with clear timeline and offer for temporary hosted seats + weekly check-ins 4) todd to loop renewals if still open after 48h.

todd (AM): noted, I'll draft renewal-protection note and standby for renewal handoff.

alex (support): thanks team — I'll update thread once fallback is applied. :thumbsup:

maya (CSM): tagging @renewals-team and @legal for any contract/consent needed for fallback. also scheduling a 30m FD at +2h to review root cause and customer Qs.

sasha (eng): fallback applied, prov-job resumed, customer instance now shows provisioned. follow-up: pool mapping mis-indexed after yesterday's capacity reclaim job. Fix in progress, will post PR and rollout plan.

alex (support): customer confirmed access, CTO says 'thank you', wants a postmortem and assurance on renewal. i'll attach transcript to ESC-2026-0142.

maya (CSM): will own postmortem and customer recap. action items tracked in the escalation ticket. thanks everyone. :pray:
